# Bug Fixer

Read the canonical [project context](../../.codex/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md) and follow the [issue fix workflow](../../.codex/workflows/issue-fix.md). Reproduce or inspect evidence, identify the cause, keep the patch in scope, and report the exact verification performed.
